newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady, holding while seeks direction.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady, holding while seeks direction.

text.p: Brent crude futures prices were indicated around the London close on Monday in Asia, in line with a steady tone on NYMEX.
August Brent was quoted on SIMEX at $17.70/$17.90 per barrel, around the London close of $17.76. August took over as the front month contract on Friday after July expired.
NYMEX August crude oil was last traded at $19.08 per barrel, up two cents from New York's close. July was last traded at $18.90, up seven cents.
Brokers said the market was undecided on direction. An upside test failed to find support on Friday in London and New York, which could indicate a further test of the downside.
However, traders said the markets might look to square up ahead of the OPEC meeting next week.
